title: Naturality of the constructed localized completed evaluation
statement: In the context of def-sf-rational-verdier-data, let w be integral constructible and hp preserve constructibility of its integral dual. Fix an ordinary tensor-Hom presentation a and a normalized Completion c. Define integralEvaluation by inverse completion followed by the actual counit of a.adjunction. Define localizedEvaluation by localizing that map and transporting its source using the tensor and localizedDual object equations. For every rational f:K to M, rational tensor(f,id) followed by localizedEvaluation(M) equals rational tensor(id,localizedDual(f.op)) followed by localizedEvaluation(K).

proof.text: The existing first-variable naturality theorem gives the ordinary evaluation square. Use naturality of the completion transformation, cancel its invertible component at (K,DM), and cancel its two other inverse components to obtain the completed integral square.

The rational tensor and dual object equations give the source equality, so localizedEvaluation is an actual composite of eqToHom and the localized integral map. Their pure-tensor arrow equations reduce the desired square on a tensor f to a tensor the completed integral square.

Induct on the tensor-product description of an arbitrary localized arrow. Zero and sum cases follow from separate additivity of tensor, additivity of dual, and distributivity of composition. The pure-tensor case is the preceding equation with coefficient multiplication by one.

theorem localizedEvaluation_natural
    (K M : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l E X) (f : K ⟶ M) :
    (tensor D l hl X E).map
        (Prod.mkHom f (𝟙 ((localizedDual l E X w hp).obj (op M)))) ≫
      localizedEvaluation D l hl X E w hp a c M =
    (tensor D l hl X E).map
        (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 K) ((localizedDual l E X w hp).map f.op)) ≫
      localizedEvaluation D l hl X E w hp a c K
